name: TOB User Reading State
description: One row per user — the server-side mirror of their last Bible reading activity, synced from the Flutter client's own local activity log (see truth_of_bible.api.notifications.record_reading_activity). Exists purely so the spiritual/reading notification scan (truth_of_bible.notifications.reading.daily_scan) is correct across a user's multiple devices — e.g. it must never nudge someone to 'continue reading' if they already read today on a different phone/tablet than the one this row happens to be updated from. Never stores or infers anything about the user beyond what book/chapter/verse they last opened and when.

fields.label: Last Read Date
fields.description: last_read_at's calendar date in the user's own preference timezone — precomputed so 'already read today' never has to redo timezone math on every scan.

fields.label: Last Book Id
fields.description: The Flutter app's own numeric Bible book id (GroupBookModel.bookId) — 'last_book' is the localized display name shown in notification copy and can't be used to navigate; this is what a deep link actually opens.

fields.label: Reading Days (Lifetime)
fields.description: Count of distinct calendar days with at least one recorded reading — used only to pick gentler/more established copy (e.g. a first-time reader vs. a regular one), never shown to the user as a score or streak.

fields.label: Last 'Continue Reading' Notified
fields.description: Dedup guard: the daily-continue nudge is sent at most once per calendar day per user.

fields.label: Inactivity Tier Notified
fields.description: Highest inactivity tier already notified since the user's last read — reset to None as soon as they read again, so a returning user is never notified about inactivity they've already ended.
